channel.description: Latest articles from New York Daily News (nydailynews.com)

item.title: Barron Trump quietly launches yerba mate beverage business: report
item.description: Barron Trump appears to have quietly become a partner in a new company selling yerba mate beverages.

item.title: Michelle Obama’s Netflix documentary surges after ‘Melania’ hits theaters
item.description: Viewership in the U.S. for "Becoming" surged over 13,000% on the opening weekend of "Melania."

item.title: 4-year-old Connecticut girl gets summoned for jury duty by mistake
item.description: A 4-year-old Connecticut girl was summoned for jury duty this week. She told her parents she "didn't want to go to jail" for not showing up.

item.title: Veterinarian died of carbon monoxide poisoning while operating on dog in Queens mobile clinic
item.description: Ashraf Hussein, 56, was found dead inside the van parked next to a thick snow bank on 65th Ave. and Parsons Blvd. in Flushing at about 9:25 a.m. Sunday. A small white dog that a co-worker said Hussein had been operating on to remove a mass in the animal’s paw also died.

item.title: Connecticut student arrested after bringing loaded gun to high school
item.description: A 16-year-old student was arrested Thursday after bringing a loaded gun to their Connecticut high school.

item.title: Harry Styles fans are selling blood to buy tickets for MSG residency
item.description: Fans of Harry Styles are pulling out all the stops — and even some blood — in an effort to afford tickets for his upcoming shows at Madison Square Garden.

item.title: Rookies flash, but Nets stumble again in Orlando after busy deadline day
item.description: Brooklyn fell to the Magic 118-98 at Kia Center, dropping to 13-37.

item.title: Reality TV star Spencer Pratt officially enters Los Angeles mayoral race
item.description: Reality TV star Spencer Pratt made it official this week, filing paperwork to enter the 2026 race for mayor of Los Angeles.

item.title: Tuberculosis cases confirmed at two Long Island high schools
item.description: Two tuberculosis cases have been confirmed at high schools on Long Island.

item.title: Asking Eric: Brother bullies siblings over aging mother’s care
item.description: Dear Eric: My mother is in her last months of life. She has been cared for in her home for the last three years by increasingly expensive home health care workers.
